newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan, Algerian interior ministers meet.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan, Algerian interior ministers meet.

text.p: Moroccan Interior Minister Driss Basri conferred in Rabat on Monday with his Algerian counterpart, Mostapha Benmansour, on ways to develop cooperation, the official MAP news agency said.
It was the highest-level meeting between the two countries since 1994, a diplomatic source said.
In September 1994, the border between Morocco and Algeria was closed after attacks blamed on "terrorists" in the southern Moroccan city of Marrakesh, where two Spanish tourists were killed.
Morocco blamed the attack on a group of Algerian nationals who were arrested and jailed for life in Morocco.
